svg.aria-label: Sketchbook page 4, drawn in crayon. IntentShield. A stranger sends a QR code saying scan this to receive money. You expect money in; in fact you pay out. Every rule check passes, but the intent check fails and the payment is flagged.
svg.title: Page 4: IntentShield

g.text: Catches UPI scams that pass every
rule, like the 'scan this QR to
Paytm Build for AI, special mention
Scan this QR to receive money
What you expect: money comes in
Every rule passes, so the payment looks legitimate. The intent does not.
